basis: 0.2.0 on branch redraw-cut-post: CutRight's frontend reduced to the editing components over an installed VideoHost; read in full
shapeReason: The editing components (TimelineEditorView, Timeline, Inspector, ColourInspector, CaptionInspector, TranscriptPanel, ChangesPanel, NativePlayer/StagePlayer, RangePreview) and the typed video engine client run over a VideoHost the app installs (engine call, events and status; native preview session; asset URLs, media scope, registered media ids, reveal). No Tauri import, no pages, settings, legal, onboarding, demo, app name or GenRight client; a deliberate index; dependencies are media-ui and react-shell only; icons are react-shell's Icon with nine editing glyphs. A second app can mount the editor without CutRight's shell. Remaining items are gaps.

cutright.note: keeps its pages and shell and supplies a Tauri VideoHost over @rightkit/tauri-shell and its playback_* commands

genright.note: could mount the timeline and player over its own host once its engine serves the video project methods

boundary: the native preview session's Rust side (playback_*) is only in CutRight's shell; RightKit has no preview-session crate yet
lib/media types every video engine method CutRight calls, including recipes, batch, bundle and package, whose servers are not in RightKit
the generation UI client shared with @rightkit/media-gen-ui is not built
actions: provide a Tauri VideoHost implementation (in the app or a tauri adapter) over @rightkit/tauri-shell
build the preview-session crate the family review proposes and point the playback host at it
publish 0.2.0 after media-ui 0.3.5, platform-ui 0.4.1 and react-shell 0.7.3

basis: new 0.1.0 on branch redraw-cut-post: rightkit-pipeline's generation engine client moved with git mv; process call from rightkit-engine-host::call
shapeReason: The client of the media-generation engine contract (the CLI rightkit-media-gen serves): GenerationClient, Orchestrator with crash-safe journal and recovery, model catalog checks, generated-source import. basis: 0.2.0 on branch redraw-cut-post; read in full and compared with HeardRight's engine supervision and rightkit-daemon's contract
shapeReason: The engine-binary framework for command engines, both sides of one CLI: the registry served as a JSON CLI and a stdio sidecar over rightkit-job-queue, and call (absolute path, stdin switch, capped capture, error envelope, contract and capability handshake) for engine-to-engine calls. The video project layer moved to rightkit-video-project (engine-commands); its doctor report was a duplicate of rightkit-doctor and is deleted, with one resource-folder rule (env::resource_dir). HeardRight's engine uses typed frames over rightkit-job-queue directly and CodeRight's service is rightkit-daemon's authorised contract, so this is the shape for the command engines (CutRight, GenRight, ScrapeRight, PostRight, MailRight), not a mandatory owner; it is not on the mandatory set.

cutright.note: its EngineError has no details field; project helpers now from rightkit-video-project

mailright.note: engine_api uses an enum error and a second envelope

postright.note: dispatch.rs can call through call::EngineProcess; its attempt rows stay in the app

heardright.note: typed EngineFrame protocol over rightkit-job-queue with a method allowlist; no command registry

coderight.note: resident service on rightkit-daemon's MethodTable contract

boundary: apps.rs installed-suite discovery is a suite-launcher concern (rightkit-app-manager)
PostRight's attempt-row and identity-sweep dispatch discipline needs an app store and is not in call
actions: keep it off the mandatory set
move apps.rs to the suite launcher crate
